title: Wharf Boathouse
specs: Single kayaks are appropriate for anyone ages 8 and up.
A single kayak is a single occupancy with a max capacity of 300lbs.
Children ages 7 or under may go in a multi-occupancy boat (double kayak, canoe, rowboat or pedal boat) with an adult as long as they can safely sit independently and fit securely in a PFD.

Children ages 8-15 years old, may go out on their own boat but their parent or guardian must complete and sign the float plan/agreement form and a supervising adult 18+ must be present on the water with them at all times.
Double kayaks are a multi occupancy boat with a max capacity of 500 lbs.
While we do not advise more than two paddlers on a double kayak, a small child (under 3ft/30lbs) may be able to fit on the small bump seat in front of rear position paddler.
Our canoes have a max capacity of 800 lbs.
This single occupancy boat is perfect for anyone 8 and up.

services.name: Cherry Blossom Kayak Tour from The Wharf Boathouse
services.desc: Cherry Blossom Tours are back! 90-120 Minutes About See the beautiful DC Cherry Blossoms in bloom! Experience the Cherry blossoms in a new way – from the water! Join our historical kayak tour along the waterfront. Learn some of our nation’s incredible history while taking in some of DC’s most majestic sights. Please note we will be staying in the Washington Channel. This kayak tour does not enter the Tidal Basin itself. No kayaks are allowed in the Basin, but there are plenty of Cherry Blossom trees to see along East Potomac Park. Experience the beauty of Washington, D.C.'s iconic 90-120 minutes • Ages 12+
